title: Rational solutions and limit cycles of polynomial and trigonometric Abel equations
summary: We study the Abel differential equation x0 = A(t)x3 + B(t)x2 +C(t)x. Specifically, we find bounds on the number of its rational solutions when A(t), B(t) and C(t) are polynomials with real or complex coefficients; and on the number of rational limit cycles when A(t), B(t) and C(t) are trigonometric polynomials with real coefficients.
